Persistent storage is unchanged. Heartbeat admission uses the native AuthorizeCall transaction extension, followed by the existing seven extension fields. The transparent outer payment adapter contains the unchanged SkipCheckIfFeeless and legacy signed-payment stack. It bypasses the signed-payer requirement only for RawOrigin::Authorized with an exact ImOnline heartbeat call and zero tip; nonzero tips are rejected. Both bare payment admission callbacks explicitly reject ImOnline heartbeats with InvalidTransaction::Call before dispatch, closing the aggregate unsigned pre-dispatch fallback; other bare calls and all signed feeless/payment/refund callbacks retain legacy behavior. AuthorizeCall adds no encoded bytes, while its metadata entry and the runtime transaction version change explicitly.
Empty batches become Normal dispatch class rather than Operational. This intentional upstream behavior may change fee/priority expectations; test in runtime policy fixtures.
